name: workflowers-cancellations-to-scw-unblock-peter

deploy.description: Peter's copy of workflowers-cancellations-to-scw-unblock. Deletion propagation for Peter's two-way calendar-blocking pair: workflowers-events-to-scw-busy-peter's event_updated trigger runs with expand_recurring: true, and in that mode Zapier silently drops cancellations. This slim workflow triggers on event_cancelled for peter@work.flowers, looks the cancelled event up in Peter's GCal Sync Map, deletes its pgao@securecodewarrior.com Busy block, and marks the row deleted. Creates and updates stay with the main Zap.

trigger.authentication_note: Peter's work.flowers Google Calendar connection ('peter@work.flowers') — the calendar whose cancellations are read. Peter's SCW credential is a --connections alias because this workflow deletes Busy blocks there.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger, fires on cancellation/deletion. `calendarid` is its only input field (verified on Dennis's copy 2026-08-31 at 1.15.0). Payload is the raw Google event with status 'cancelled', per-occurrence ids for recurring instances. A series truncated with 'this and following' produces NO tombstones for the vanished occurrences — gcal-block-sweep-peter's reconcile pass removes those orphans.

connections_note: gcal_scw is Peter's SCW Google Calendar connection ('pgao@securecodewarrior.com') — where this workflow deletes the Busy blocks that workflowers-events-to-scw-busy-peter / gcal-block-sweep-peter created.
sharing_note: Peter's connections (02b0ea0a-… work.flowers, 02edd3ce-… SCW) and the GCal Sync Map (Peter) table 01M2HT9XPZEASFV09J4A3QTDGT are owned by Peter's own Zapier profile, not the CI identity. The publish pipeline's CI identity must be able to use all three, so they are shared with the work.flowers account before merge — see gcal-block-sweep-peter/README.md. Shared on: 2026-09-25.

tables.01M2HT9XPZEASFV09J4A3QTDGT: GCal Sync Map (Peter) — shared with Peter's whole blocking family, never with Dennis's. Read for the loop guard (a cancelled event whose id is a Mirror Event ID is the sync's own deletion echoing back) and the mapping lookup; the matched row's Status is written to 'deleted'.

description: Peter's copy: work.flowers calendar cancellations → delete the corresponding private Busy block on Peter's SCW calendar and mark the GCal Sync Map (Peter) row deleted.
